rounds.q: What % of the world's people speak English, at any level?
rounds.why: That's about 1.5 billion people. Mandarin Chinese is next, with about 1.2 billion.
rounds.fun: English tops the chart, yet about 4 in 5 people get by without it!

rounds.q: What % of Americans (5+) speak a language besides English at home?
rounds.why: That's about 74.1 million people. Back in 1980, it was only about 1 in 10.
rounds.src: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey (2024 data)
rounds.fun: Nearly 1 in 4 Americans speak another language at home. How cool is that!

rounds.q: How many letters are in the world's longest alphabet?
rounds.why: It's Khmer, from Cambodia. That count includes some letters no longer in use.
rounds.fun: 74 letters! Good luck singing that alphabet song in one breath.

rounds.q: How many languages are spoken in the world today?
rounds.why: About 44% of them are endangered, often with fewer than 1,000 users left.
rounds.src: Ethnologue, How Many Languages Are There in the World? (2025-26 data)
rounds.fun: 7,170 languages! That's a whole lot of ways to say hi.

rounds.q: How many native languages are spoken in Papua New Guinea?
rounds.why: That's in a country of about 10.5 million people, roughly one language per 12,500.
rounds.src: Ethnologue, Papua New Guinea country profile (2025-26 data)
rounds.fun: 840 languages in one country. Talk about a chatty neighborhood!
